title: Marvel Has Assigned 42 Hours of Homework Before ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
summary: Marvel and Disney+ have issued a stacked watch list for fans ahead of the cinema release of Avengers: Doomsday on December 18. The studio also launched the Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast, available on Disney+, YouTube, and audio platforms.
